children: SoSoValue holders approved SIP-3, allocating 50,000,000 SOSO (5% of total supply) from the Ecosystem Fund reserve to the ValueChain Ecosystem Incentive Treasury. The vote received 99.94% support from 978 voting addresses, and the tokens will be released in phases as incentives are earned.

The allocation gives governance an approved framework for funding liquidity incentives, builder grants, and staking rewards. That creates a phased mechanism for directing SOSO toward ecosystem activity rather than releasing the full allocation at once. Distribution details, including how incentives are earned and released, are to follow through governance.
Thank you to everyone who participated. 978 addresses cast their votes, and the results are in:
With overwhelming consensus, the community has approved the allocation of 50,000,000

title: SoSoValue: Holders approve SIP-3 allocation - 30 Aug 2026
